title: Photography Tutorial and Camera Setup Infographic
description: An advanced prompt for generating instructional infographics for photography. It takes a reference image and breaks down the camera position, distance, height, and angle, providing a clear 'how-to' guide for recreating the shot.
promptText:
Using [{argument name="reference image" default="Image 1 Reference"}] as the sole visual basis, generate a vertical 3:4 {argument name="teaching topic" default="street photography knowledge analysis chart"} (educational infographic poster). Goal: Use clear and interesting diagrams to explain "subject position, camera position, lens/distance, camera height, shooting angle, and composition points" for the purpose of teaching others how to recreate the shot. Overall style: Clean and high-end photography tutorial infographic + light scrapbook-style annotations; light off-white paper texture or light gray background; mainly black, white, and gray; automatically extract 1–2 colors from Image 1 as accents; sharp lines, high information density but not cluttered, unified alignment, and strong readability.

Mandatory Rules:
- Must preserve the following from Image 1: subject pose, relative position between subject and environment, main background structural lines, lighting direction, and spatial logic.
- Do not change the pose or the scene; only provide an "analytical diagrammatic presentation."
- Faces are not the focus: they can be lightly blurred/simplified, no realistic beautification, no emphasis on facial features.
- Full Chinese; no English, no brand names, no watermarks, no UI interface elements.

Fixed Layout (remains the same every time, does not change with Image 1):
1) Main Visual Area (upper half or large image on the left): Place the "Reference Scene Display" (lightly stylized/illustrated based on Image 1, but with recognizable scene and posture), overlaid with: rule-of-thirds grid, subject outline box, leading line prompts, vertical/horizontal line correction prompts; use numbered dots + hand-drawn arrows to mark key points (subject landing point, negative space direction, leg extension direction, background leading line source).
2) Diagram Area (two side-by-side images on the right or bottom half):
- Top View: Use minimalist icons to draw wall/street/building boundaries (abstracted from Image 1), subject position (person icon), camera position (camera icon); must show shooting direction arrows, distance between subject and camera (dashed line + numerical range), recommended position points A/B (two alternative positions); camera orientation must match Image 1 (front/side/oblique, etc.).
- Side View: Draw ground line, subject height示意, camera height示意, tilt angle sector; must show camera height range from ground (reasonably inferred from Image 1), lens tilt angle range (reasonably inferred from Image 1); low angle/eye level/high angle must be correct.
3) Parameter Card Area (three fixed rounded-corner cards at the bottom):
- Card 1: Lens and Distance (give recommended equivalent focal length range + shooting distance range).
- Card 2: Camera Height and Angle (give camera height range + tilt angle range).
- Card 3: Pose and Body Points (summarize key points of the pose in Image 1 using short sentences).
4) Error Demonstration Area (fixed at the bottom right): 3 red-cross error prompts (automatically generated based on the most relevant issues in Image 1, short sentences), for example: don't use ultra-wide angle too close to the face, don't crop toes/fingers, don't use a camera position that's too high resulting in distorted proportions (adjust automatically based on Image 1's actual situation).

Automatic Inference Requirements (to make it usable for any replacement of Image 1):
- Automatically infer and write into the diagrams based on Image 1: camera orientation, camera height, shooting distance interval, equivalent focal length interval, subject landing point and cropping strategy, background leading line source.
- All numerical values should be expressed as "ranges" (credible and reproducible), do not provide a single fixed number.

Output Requirements:
High definition, sharp lines, natural shadows, unified icons, neat layout, readable information; no garbled text, no logos, no watermarks, no excessive decoration.

Negative Constraints:
No watermarks, no logos, no English, no garbled text, no overly realistic faces, no exaggerated cartoon proportions, no limb deformities/extra fingers, no cluttered layouts, no low resolution, no heavy filters, no changes to the subject pose or scene relationship of Image 1.

promptText:

- Armani: Low-saturation gray tones, high-end and restrained
- Chanel: Minimalist black and white, rational and stylish

- Chinese text must be clear and accurate
- Clean layout, complete information, suitable for social media sharing
- Keep the character identity consistent, only comparing lip color differences

This is a visual recommendation based on image and temperament; do not make medical judgments or absolute conclusions.

title: Urban Basketball Sneaker Poster Design
description: A high-impact advertising poster prompt for street basketball sneakers, blending hyper-realistic product photography with aggressive black-ink sports illustration.
promptText: Create an ultra-premium street basketball sneaker advertising poster for an original brand called VANTAGE X, designed as a Cannes-level key visual that fuses luxury product photography, aggressive black-ink sports illustration, and explosive urban editorial typography. Preserve the exact core structure and camera logic of the image: one monumental hyper-real high-top basketball sneaker dominates the lower foreground in an extreme low-angle perspective, while a giant hand-drawn basketball player erupts across the upper background in a violent forward-driving action pose. The final image must now combine stronger Orbit impact, tighter Transit system control, and bolder Port-level concept integration, so the shoe feels like the source of all motion, power, and graphic force in the poster. Core composition: Use a tall vertical poster with one oversized sneaker in the lower-left to lower-center foreground, pushed slightly closer to the viewer for greater visual pressure. The toe box, side emblem, collar, laces, and outsole must feel monumental and tactile, as if the shoe is stepping directly into the viewer’s space. Behind and above it, place one huge black-ink sketch basketball player in an extreme explosive drive, jump, or pre-dunk attack moment, twisting through the frame with sharp momentum. Add one smaller secondary sketched player in the mid-background for layered court rhythm. The shoe must be the first thing seen; the illustrated players act as amplified motion ghosts generated by the shoe’s energy. Orbit impact enhancement: Increase the visual aggression of the foreground shoe. Make the sole impact at the base feel like it detonates the composition through bold black brush bursts, ink spray, fractured motion streaks, and launch-like ground energy. Tighten the distance between camera and shoe so the product feels heavier, closer, and more dominant. The poster must hit instantly with a “one step breaks the frame” sensation. Transit system enhancement: Keep the same skeletal layout, but unify the entire visual language into a mature black-and-white street-illustration system with one controlled hero product color event. The background athlete linework, speed lines, sketch shading, annotation marks, headline typography, secondary text, and impact splashes must all follow one disciplined graphic grammar: consistent ink weight, consistent roughness, consistent motion direction, and coordinated negative-space balance. The whole piece must feel like an official international sports campaign poster, not a collage of separate ideas. Port concept enhancement: Push the concept so the athlete’s motion visibly originates from the sneaker. Let selected ink lines, force strokes, and motion arcs extend from the shoe edges, outsole, and side emblem into the illustrated player’s limbs and trajectory, creating a clear idea that the player’s explosive action is being driven by the sneaker itself. The giant player can be captured in a more extreme airborne breakthrough or pre-slam moment, with the action lines visually tethered back to the shoe. The concept must feel bold and intelligent, not gimmicky. Product design: Design the shoe as a premium globally market-ready high-top street basketball sneaker from VANTAGE X. Use a bold colorway of metallic bronze-gold, matte black, off-white, and subtle silver technical accents. The upper should combine structured leather, engineered support panels, padded ankle protection, reinforced lace wings, sculpted heel geometry, and performance-driven outsole logic. Add an original VANTAGE X emblem on the lateral side. The shoe must feel elite, urban, muscular, and collectible. Material realism: Render the sneaker with exceptional realism and sharp commercial detail. The bronze-gold leather must feel smooth, rich, and premium with controlled highlights. Black areas must feel deep and performance-oriented with distinct texture separation. Show crisp stitching, lace weave, rubber density, sole grip, collar padding, and precise panel edges. The product must feel expensive, durable, and technically believable. Illustration style: Render the players and court world in expressive black ink sketch style with editorial sports aggression: raw contour lines, scratch shading, manga-like force marks, speed streaks, splatter accents, rough court geometry, and brush-impact sweeps. The drawn world should remain powerful but clearly secondary to the shoe. Keep the illustration highly art-directed, not messy. Typography and copy: Add fully original English typography integrated into the composition. Use one powerful headline such as “OWN THE ASPHALT” or “RISE ABOVE IMPACT,” rendered in a sharp custom street-sport editorial style. Add a refined support line such as “Engineered for explosive lift, locked grip, and court-born dominance.” Include a small premium VANTAGE X brand mark. Typography must feel dynamic, urban, aggressive, and compositionally precise. No copied wording, no generic font block. Background and environment: Keep the environment mostly white and minimal, constructed from perspective court lines, urban fragments, black ink slashes, motion scratches, and negative space. Use explosive black brushwork near the shoe base to anchor the product and visually launch the athlete upward. The environment must feel graphic and fast, never cluttered. Lighting: Use premium studio lighting on the sneaker, with soft directional highlights from upper-left and front-left, giving the metallic bronze-gold surfaces a luxurious glow. The illustration can remain flatter and more graphic, but should align with the shoe’s motion and shadow logic. The contrast between hyper-real product lighting and raw ink energy is essential. Color direction: Keep the overall palette tightly controlled: white field, black illustration system, bronze-gold hero product surfaces, black technical components, off-white sole accents, and minimal silver highlights. The shoe must remain the dominant color event in the frame. Mood: explosive, urban, dominant, athletic, rebellious, premium, graphic, collectible, aggressive, editorial, high-performance, street-basketball energy. Rendering style: ultra-premium sneaker campaign poster, oversized hyper-real basketball shoe, extreme low-angle perspective, giant black-ink sketch athlete, unified street illustration system, motion lines extending from shoe into athlete action, luxury material realism, dynamic editorial typography, 8k, world-class advertising image quality. Negative prompt: copied logos, copied slogans, generic shoe design, weak foreground shoe, cluttered background, soft blurry sneaker, cheap comic style, flat materials, plastic-looking bronze panels, messy typography, low-resolution sketch lines, weak motion, generic sports ad, over-rendered city background

title: Magazine Style Swimsuit Lookbook Poster

promptText: Generate a 3:4 vertical high-information poster 'Swimwear Selection Guide | Photo-friendly Styles'. The overall style is high-end swimwear brand Lookbook + fashion magazine information structure + Old Money vacation cinematic feel. The image must feature: creamy bokeh, moderate film grain, realistic skin texture, Kodachrome/natural light. High information density but clear and readable; all text must be real and readable Chinese; no English words anywhere in the image. [Canvas and Layout Lock (Must be strictly enforced)] - Aspect Ratio: 3:4 vertical. - Magazine grid alignment and uniform white space, fixed module positions. - Coordinate system: top-left (0,0), bottom-right (100,100), strictly following the areas below. A | Right-side Full-bleed Main Visual (Must be a large full-bleed image like reference image 2) - Area: x=52–100, y=0–100 (Right, top, and bottom edges bleed to canvas borders) - Image: An adult female model, 24–28 years old, Asian girl with a mixed Chinese-Korean look; cold white delicate skin with a vintage pearlescent glow; small V-shaped face; almond or fox eyes with a sharp edge, deep and spirited; straight bridge of the nose; full and elegant lip shape. Golden body proportions, high waist, long legs, elegant neck and shoulder lines, smooth collarbone and back lines. Hairstyle is vintage large-curl bob or low-bun wet look. - Character and image quality must include: creamy bokeh, moderate film grain, realistic skin texture, Kodachrome/natural light. - Styling: 'Set' presentation of photo-friendly swimwear (main swimwear + outer wear/minimal accessory accents), not vulgar or erotic, not lingerie-like, not athletic. - Style auto-determined but priority given to: High-waisted vintage bikini / Classic square-neck one-piece / High-waisted skirted swimwear (restrained) / Vintage halter deep-V / Off-the-shoulder vintage / Wide-strap high-coverage one-piece / Metal buckle decorated two-piece (small metal accents, restrained). - Color preference: Burgundy, deep navy blue, vintage gold, olive green, cream white, chocolate brown, metallic champagne gold (overall high-end cinematic feel, no neon or high saturation). - Pose: Standing naturally, confident and elegant (front or 3/4 profile), emphasizing long legs, snatched waist, sculpted abdomen, shoulders, collarbones, and elegant back curves; no provocative or erotic poses. - Bleed cut: Slight cropping of the top of the head or feet allowed, but overall must be high-end, correctly proportioned, and high-tension. - Mandate: The main character image must be clean; no overlapping lines, arrows, numbered points, or text on the character; no superimposed small images/thumbnails/picture-in-picture. B | Left-side Information Zone (Only information cards, no main image overlays) - Total left area: x=6–48, y=6–96 - Uniform card style: Rounded light background, restrained dividers, icons + text, magazine-style layout, rich in text and images but not crowded; overall tone matches the right main image's 'Vintage Old Money Cinematic Feel'. B0 | Left-side Main Title Area (Fixed position) - Area: x=6–48, y=6–16 - Format: Light semi-transparent rounded title box, restrained fine dividers, relaxed letter spacing. - Fixed text: - Main Title: Swimwear Selection Guide | Photo-friendly Styles - Subtitle: Photo-friendly Swimwear | High-quality Series C | Part Close-ups (Four images, more exquisite, shorter overall height) - Card area: x=6–48, y=18–44 - Title: Part Close-ups - 2x2 four close-up images, more refined and branded: uniform rounded corners, light shadows, uniform color temperature, clear texture; shorter image height, more white space; short two-line caption below each image. - Four fixed items (Must be cropped from the actual swimwear on the right): 01 Chest structure: cup shape/folds/knots and key points connecting straps or neckline, more 3D on camera 02 Bottom/hip cut: high-waisted cutlines and hip coverage/slits or side structures, looking cleaner and leg-lengthening 03 Back design: back lines are more photogenic, stable and less prone to shifting 04 Fabric and lining: fabric texture and lining layers, skin-friendly and reassuring - Mandate: Only numbering within modules, no cross-column lines to the main character. D | Support Structure and Parameters (Fixed 7 lines) - Card area: x=6–48, y=46–66 - Title: Support Structure and Parameters - Presented as 'Icon + Text + Stars' (restrained and beautiful): - Chest pads: Yes - Removable pads: Yes - Support level: Medium (Star rating: ★★★☆☆) - Coverage: Medium (Star rating: ★★★☆☆) - Stability: Medium (Star rating: ★★★☆☆) - Adjustable straps: Yes - Suitable for long photo shoots: Yes - Fixed small text at the bottom: Favors photography output | Not for high-intensity swimming training E | Recommended Scenarios + Pitfall Reminders (Split top/bottom in the same card) - Card area: x=6–48, y=68–96 E1 Scenarios (Top half) - Title: Recommended Scenarios - List using 'Scenario Icon + Name + Short Supplement': - Vintage Beach Club: Enhances Old Money vacation vibe - Old Wooden Pier Sunset: Stronger cinematic lighting - Mediterranean White Villa Pool: Clean, noble, and photogenic - Classic Yacht Shoot: Crisp lines, high-end relaxation - Vintage Resort Balcony: Composition like a film still - Palm Avenue Beach: Richer vintage vacation feel - Old Hollywood Style Coastal Estate: More dramatic tension - Modern Art Deco Pool: Modern, intellectual, high-end (If space is limited, use two-column layout but keep readable.) E2 Pitfall Reminders (Bottom half) - Title: Pitfall Reminders - Fixed 3 points (with small icons/illustrations, clear short sentences): 1) High-waisted vintage enhances proportions but demands waist/abdomen lines: choose smooth stretch and waist cutlines to avoid marks affecting shots 2) Metal accessories oxidize more easily after getting wet: prioritize corrosion-resistant materials, rinse and dry promptly after shooting 3) Dark fabrics absorb more heat and change fit when wet: choose high-density double linings for stability in comfort and texture E3 Conclusion Line (Fixed, check/cross icons) - More suitable for photo scenarios (Check) - Light water immersion okay (Check) - Not suitable for high-intensity water sports (Cross) [Background and Overall Vibe (Fixed requirements)] - Background atmosphere suggested from: Vintage Beach Club, Mediterranean White Villa Pool, Classic Yacht, Vintage Resort Balcony, Palm Avenue Beach, Old Hollywood Coastal Estate, Modern Art Deco Pool; background must be restrainedly blurred, not competing with main visual. - Overall layout: Magazine-level alignment, clear hierarchy, high info density without crowding; avoid e-commerce detail page feel; text must be clear, readable, and non-garbled. [Strong Constraints and Avoidance (Mandatory)] - No English words anywhere in the image. - Main character must be clean: no overlapping lines, numbers, arrows, or labels; no picture-in-picture. - No excessive sweet ruffles, no modern minimalist coldness, no sporty functional style, no large mesh/cutouts, no neon high saturation, no cartoon prints, no low-waist exposure, no thick sponge pads. - Not vulgar, not erotic, no exaggerated sexy poses; correct human anatomy with no extra fingers.
